body.purpose: Profile names, tabs, buttons, and actionable rows.

label.purpose: Endpoints, engines, tags, counts, shortcuts, and status details.

shadows.name: modal-command-surface
shadows.purpose: Command palette above its dimmed backdrop.

components.name: Compact Filled Button
components.description: Primary operation within an already active workspace context.
components.css: .ds-button-filled { height: 18px; padding: 0 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #ebebec; color: #242529; font: 400 10px/1 IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-button-filled:hover { background: #dfdfe0; } .ds-button-filled:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #7d82e8; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-button-filled:active { background: #cacaca; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-button-filled { background: #2e343e; color: #dce0e5; } .ds-button-filled:hover { background: #363c46; } .ds-button-filled:focus-visible { outline-color: #47679e; } .ds-button-filled:active { background: #454a56; } }

components.name: Compact Outlined Button
components.css: .ds-button-outlined { height: 18px; padding: 0 4px; border: 1px solid #c9c9ca; border-radius: 4px; background: #ebebec; color: #242529; font: 400 10px/1 IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-button-outlined:hover { background: #dfdfe0; } .ds-button-outlined:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #7d82e8; } .ds-button-outlined:active { background: #cacaca; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-button-outlined { border-color: #464b57; background: #2e343e; color: #dce0e5; } .ds-button-outlined:hover { background: #363c46; } .ds-button-outlined:focus-visible { border-color: #47679e; } .ds-button-outlined:active { background: #454a56; } }

components.name: Connection Profile Row
components.description: Full-width sidebar row carrying profile identity and runtime metadata.
components.css: .ds-profile-row { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #242529; text-align: left; font: 400 12px/1.3 IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-profile-row span:last-child { display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-profile-row strong { font-weight: 500; } .ds-profile-row small { color: #58585a; font-size: 10px; } .ds-profile-row:hover { background: #dfdfe0; } .ds-profile-row:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #7d82e8; } .ds-profile-dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #336791; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-profile-row { color: #dce0e5; } .ds-profile-row small { color: #a9afbc; } .ds-profile-row:hover { background: #363c46; } .ds-profile-row:focus-visible { border-color: #47679e; } }

components.name: Active Query Tab
components.description: Active tab connects the tab strip to the editor surface.
components.css: .ds-query-tab { min-width: 112px; height: 36px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #c9c9ca; border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0; background: #fafafa; color: #242529; font: 500 12px/1 IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-query-tab:hover { background: #dfdfe0; } .ds-query-tab:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #7d82e8; outline-offset: -2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-query-tab { border-color: #464b57; background: #282c33; color: #dce0e5; } .ds-query-tab:hover { background: #363c46; } .ds-query-tab:focus-visible { outline-color: #47679e; } }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Labeled profile field with visible focus and validation boundaries.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: #242529; font: 400 12px/1.3 IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid #c9c9ca; border-radius: 6px; background: #fafafa; color: #242529; font: inherit; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #b9b9ba; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #7d82e8; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-field { color: #dce0e5; } .ds-field input { border-color: #363c46; background: #282c33; color: #dce0e5; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #464b57; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #47679e; } }

components.name: Command Palette
components.css: .ds-palette { width: 560px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #c9c9ca; border-radius: 8px; background: #ebebec; color: #242529; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,.10), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,.10); font: 400 12px/1.3 IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-palette > input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #c9c9ca; background: #fafafa; color: inherit; font: inherit; } .ds-palette > input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #7d82e8; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-palette button { width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; text-align: left; font: inherit; } .ds-palette button:hover, .ds-palette button:focus-visible { outline: none; background: #cacaca; } .ds-palette button span { display: grid; } .ds-palette small, .ds-palette kbd { color: #58585a; font-size: 10px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-palette { border-color: #464b57; background: #2f343e; color: #dce0e5; } .ds-palette > input { border-color: #464b57; background: #282c33; } .ds-palette > input:focus-visible { outline-color: #47679e; } .ds-palette button:hover, .ds-palette button:focus-visible { background: #454a56; } .ds-palette small, .ds-palette kbd { color: #a9afbc; } }

components.name: Transient Notification
components.description: Dismissible semantic status message above the workspace.
components.css: .ds-notice { width: 360px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #5c78e2 35%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #5c78e2 10%, #ebebec); color: #5c78e2; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,.10), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.10); font: 400 10px/1.4 IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-notice:hover { border-color: #5c78e2; } .ds-notice:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #7d82e8; outline-offset: 1px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-notice { border-color: #293b5b; background: color-mix(in srgb, #74ade8 10%, #2f343e); color: #74ade8; } .ds-notice:hover { border-color: #74ade8; } .ds-notice:focus-visible { outline-color: #47679e; } }

narrative.overview:
Astesia is a compact, neutral desktop workspace built for sustained database operation. Its visual system keeps connections, query context, results, and runtime state continuously visible while allowing the native editor and data to remain the dominant material.

The shell follows the operating system by default through the paired One Light and One Dark themes. It uses familiar desktop controls, shallow tonal separation, small labels, and dense toolbars instead of decorative branding or oversized presentation typography.
keyCharacteristics: Compact multi-pane geometry with a fixed connection sidebar, tabbed work area, and persistent status bar.
Theme-semantic surfaces and text, with color reserved for focus, engine identity, and meaningful status.
Native Zed UI controls and a local Zed editor, with Simplified Chinese and English occupying the same visual hierarchy.
Borders and tonal layers establish structure; elevation is reserved for temporary overlays.

rules.name: The Semantic Surface Rule
rules.body: New shell surfaces use the active theme's workspace, panel, editor, border, text, and muted roles; they do not introduce an independent gray palette.

rules.name: The Identity-Is-Not-Action Rule
rules.body: Engine colors identify Connection Profiles and database types. Actions continue to use native control states and the focus color.

rules.name: The State-Is-Written Rule
rules.body: Connection and error state always includes text or an icon; the green, amber, red, and gray status dots never carry meaning alone.

rules.name: The Two-Scale Rule
rules.body: Shell chrome stays primarily at body and label sizes. Larger type belongs to modal structure supplied by the native component library, not routine workspace chrome.

rules.name: The Editor Owns Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace type is for editable query content and code-like values, not for general labels or navigation.

rules.name: The Continuous-State Rule
rules.body: Hiding the connection sidebar may enlarge the work area, but the tab strip and status bar remain present so query and runtime context is not lost.

rules.name: The Overlay-Only Elevation Rule
rules.body: Shadows signal temporary content above the workspace. Persistent application structure uses borders and tonal layering.

dos: Do use the current theme's semantic roles for every persistent surface, separator, text tier, and focus state.
Do keep operational state visible in labels, status summaries, notices, or icons in addition to color.
Do preserve compact row heights, internal scrolling, and the sidebar–tabs–status composition for new Milestone 3 surfaces.
Do use the engine identity set only where database type or Connection Profile identity is being communicated.
donts: Don't add large display typography, decorative gradients, glass effects, or standalone marketing-style cards to the operator workspace.
Don't use shadows on persistent panes, toolbars, tabs, rows, or data grids.
Don't turn status or engine colors into generic primary-button colors.
Don't replace text status with color-only dots, especially for errors, connection activity, or Usage Lease state.
